summary: StartWorkflowUpdateWithStartInput lacks rpc_metadata unlike other API inputs, breaking the consistent interceptor pattern for composite operations. The fix adds top-level rpc_metadata and rpc_timeout to the composite input.
userImpact: Users implementing interceptors to refresh headers in rpc_metadata cannot apply the same pattern to composite operations like start_update_with_start_workflow.
rootCause: StartWorkflowUpdateWithStartInput as a composite container lacks rpc_metadata field that other API inputs have, breaking the consistent interceptor contract.
proposedFix: Add top-level rpc_metadata and rpc_timeout fields to StartWorkflowUpdateWithStartInput and thread them through to the execute_multi_operation gRPC call (PR #1588).
resolutionDetails: PR #1588 adds top-level rpc_metadata and rpc_timeout to StartWorkflowUpdateWithStartInput and threads them through execute_multi_operation.
keyQuote: It would be great to have the API for the interceptor remain consistent so that for composite/multiop calls, the container's rpc_metadata is projected into each of the contained ops.
